dedupe_keys.name: finnish layered timber truss floor displacement and vibration tests

description: This Zenodo release documents full-scale load and vibration experiments on an intermediate floor assembled from glued timber trusses in a Finnish structural engineering laboratory. The article describes adding OSB sheathing, gypsum ceilings, concrete topping and lightweight partitions in stages, then recording static displacements under water-tank loading and vibration after heel-drop excitation. Zenodo lists raw_data.zip, displacement and fundamental-frequency workbooks and drawings that explain supports, layers and measurement points, under CC BY 4.0. The dataset can check stiffness and dynamic-response assumptions for building floor simulations, but it is not an occupied-building monitoring series or a tested portfolio of timber products. One assembly, specific layer sequence and controlled excitation are limitations for generalizing serviceability. A reviewer-assessed use is comparing a floor finite-element model with measured displacement and natural frequency. model-opensees is a related structural solver; no model file or parameter fit was provided or run here. No raw archive, workbook or PDF was downloaded.
